sentinel: SUCCESS:RES-0094 in the receipt AND an N>=5 repeated-run variance figure plus an unpin-and-increase control

legacy_root.caveat: Strongest caveat: numbers are from an isolated local harness, not from N hosted-agent API traces. Residual variance 0 does not license a claim that production agent runs are byte-identical.
legacy_root.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:RES-0094 in the receipt AND an N>=5 repeated-run variance figure plus an unpin-and-increase control
legacy_root.question: What makes two identical agent runs differ (sampling, tool ordering, clock, network, model version drift, concurrent siblings), which of those can be pinned, and what is the residual variance after pinning everything pinnable?

residual_variance_after_pinning.interpretation: After pinning seed, frozen clock, sorted tools, fixture network, model_id, and an isolated sibling file, this local harness produced one transcript sha256 across N>=5 repeats (sample variance 0). That is residual discrete output variance on the isolated simulator, not a claim that hosted LLM agent APIs are deterministic.
unpinnable_remainder: Silent model snapshot rotation behind a name
Live network retries and body drift
A live worktree mutating under concurrent siblings

sources_of_nondeterminism.how: Fix RNG seed locally. Hosted LLM APIs often do not honor seeds even at temperature 0.
sources_of_nondeterminism.residual_if_unpinned: token_sum and transcript sha256 vary across repeats

sources_of_nondeterminism.how: Sort tool names; set PYTHONHASHSEED=0 so hash-randomized dict order cannot leak.
Write SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH / frozen unix time into the transcript; do not stamp time.time_ns().
Disable live fetches; serve a fixture body. Real tool HTTP cannot be pinned.
Record model_id. A vendor can rotate weights behind the same id.
Read an isolated scratch fixture, not a project-keyed live worktree.
Label live-tree fingerprints SAMPLE. Refuse FROZEN while start-hash != end-hash.
sources_of_nondeterminism.residual_if_unpinned: any path the agent reads can change mid-series

legacy_root.strongest_surviving_counterargument: A hosted agent with temperature 0 can still differ across repeats because the vendor sampler and model snapshot are not under this pin set.
legacy_root.title: Enumerate the sources of nondeterminism in an agent run and which are controllable
